headline: Cal State LA concede twice in nine matches
dek: Cal State LA's win over UC Merced was their eighth in nine matches, with one draw and no defeats, and UC Merced's goal was only the second they have conceded all season. Cal State San Bernardino, the conference's other unbeaten side, also won on the day.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fresno Pacific have scored 29 goals, more than any other programme, shared among ten different scorers, and have still lost four matches; goals alone have not kept them unbeaten.

wire.line: Cal State LA and Cal State San Bernardino have both won again and are still the only unbeaten sides in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches have passed their date with no result recorded, every one of them in August; the latest is Chico State's match with Yuba.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State San Bernardino have won seven and drawn two after beating Chico State at home, and have conceded four goals across those nine matches.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State East Bay have conceded 31 goals in ten matches, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Stanislaus State have drawn four of their ten matches, more draws than any other side in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Zion Vaughn has scored eight of Fresno Pacific's 29 goals.

last_match.line: UC Merced's goal was a rarity: only Stanislaus State had scored against Cal State LA before them. Cal State LA remain unbeaten.

next_match.line: Fresno Pacific are the conference's top scorers but lost at Cal State East Bay last time out; Cal State Dominguez Hills arrive on successive wins.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
